t0.text: *diagnose what just landed on you before you reach for a tool*, because using tactic defenses on a style clash turns you into the aggressor.

t1.title: Topic-Survival + Light-Shift Test
t1.text: Run the **Topic-Survival + Light-Shift Test**: after an overlap, check *whose topic survived*.

options.label: Cooperative overlap keeps your thread alive
hostile interruption hijacks the floor to pivot elsewhere

style.title: Style
style.text: Adjust your pace or tone by one notch before lecturing anyone on style.

t2.title: Incident #1 Light Test
t2.text: Run the **Incident #1 Light Test**: deliver one neutral, fact-anchored check ("I want to make sure we're still on for Friday").

options.label: deflection, amnesia, or counter-blame confirm a tactic

blind.title: Style or Blind Spot

lead.text: Surprise followed by adaptation clears the room as Style or Blind Spot

blind.text: Use **Power-Calibrated Naming**: laterally with peers or friends, keep it plain ("I notice X, and I wonder how we want to decide this"). Upward across a hierarchy, anchor in a shared goal plus an objective fact plus genuine openness ("I want to support your goal on X; I noticed we finalized Y—am I missing a constraint?").

t3.title: Tactic

lead.text: denial, evasion, or turning your check into an indictment of your tone confirms a Tactic.

t3.text: three **always-on guardrails** running underneath every sentence—**Actions over intentions** (Move 1), **Stay in the here and now** (Move 5), and **Keep responsibility where it belongs** (Move 6)—and **three response moves matched to the type of push**.

options.label: someone dodges your *ask or proposal* with a vague "maybe,"
someone pushes back on your *clean no* with excuses, flattery, or guilt
they keep crossing after three calm repeats—or repeat a clear violation

m2.title: Move 2
m2.text: When someone dodges your *ask or proposal* with a vague "maybe," deploy **Move 2 (Direct yes/no request)**.

m3.title: Move 3
m3.text: When someone pushes back on your *clean no* with excuses, flattery, or guilt, deploy **Move 3 (Fogging + Broken record, up to three times)**.

m4.title: Move 4
m4.text: When they keep crossing after three calm repeats—or repeat a clear violation—deploy **Move 4 (Boundary with consequence)**, which must pass three structural tests: (a) 100% unilaterally executable by you, (b) protective rather than retaliatory, and (c) something you are genuinely ready to execute today.

r9.title: Safety Rule #9
r9.text: And remember Safety Rule #9: harassment, discrimination, threats, or abuse belong with HR, legal, or outside support with a written record, never inside everyday dojo scripts.

ask.title: Brown Ask Tree
ask.intro: By weighing Distance (**D**), Power (**P**), and Imposition (**R**), you stop wrapping asks by anxious reflex and start choosing the exact shock absorber the room requires.

faces.text: **Positive Face** (the want that your goals and traits be seen as desirable, ratified, and included by others) and **Negative Face** (the want of every competent adult that their actions remain unimpeded)

bands.risk: Reads as dominance if P or R is high.

bands.best: Critique or no to someone who values belonging.
Asking someone senior/proud; high P or R.

surviving.title: The 3-Second Surviving-Ask Test
surviving.text: Read your drafted ask and delete the wrap mentally. Is there a single, unambiguous proposal left standing (*what you want + by when*)? If not, the wrap swallowed the ask.
